title: Exam Terminology Across Spain & Latin America

sections.content:
Key verbs for exam results:

• To pass: aprobar (o→ue: apruebo, aprobé, aprobado)
• To fail: suspender (Spain: suspendí el examen) / reprobar (Latin America: reprobé el examen)
• To get a grade: sacar una buena / mala nota

items.spanish: Carlos aprobó todas las asignaturas este semestre.
items.english: Carlos passed all subjects this semester.

items.spanish: Tengo que repetir el examen parcial porque suspendí.
items.english: I have to retake the midterm because I failed.
